body:
PR #1976 (BUG-1231, mailbox --subject): APPROVED — verdict recorded.

Verdict: .aida/review-verdicts/BUG-1231.json + PR-1976.json (handshake), sha f1c2b5e6d1a.

What I verified independently (not from the PR description):
- On current main, 0 commits behind. Merges clean.
- cargo test -p aida-core --lib mailbox -> 33 passed, incl. the new
  build_notice_prefers_explicit_subject_over_body_first_line.
- cargo test -p aida-cli-lib --lib mailbox -> 25 passed.
- The --in-reply-to path swap from reply_target_thread to resolve_mailbox_message is a
  strict widening (exact OR unique prefix), so a short-id reply now joins the right thread
  instead of silently opening a new one. That is an unadvertised improvement.

Four findings, all recorded on the verdict, none blocking (all additive, zero regression):
1. MCP send_message cannot set a subject; schema + handler + read_inbox shape untouched.
   Directly against the CLAUDE.md CLI/MCP parity rule. Filed BUG-1461.
2. aida tui mail pane still titles rows from the body first line
   (aida-tui/src/redesign/mail.rs:36). The helper's own comment says it mirrors the core
   projection; that mirror is now stale, so the feature is invisible in the default
   product face. Filed BUG-1462.
3. --subject "" prints an empty bold line (print_mailbox_line lacks the trim check that
   core's subject_line has).
4. On an AMBIGUOUS --in-reply-to prefix the warning says "matches no known message",
   which is the wrong reason.

BUG-1461 and BUG-1462 are filed as DRAFT — disposition is your gate, not mine.

Merge is blocked on infrastructure, not on review: gh auth on this machine is dead
(HTTP 401, token invalid), so I can neither read CI status nor merge. Anonymous git
fetch of PR refs still works, which is how I reviewed. Someone needs to run
`gh auth login -h github.com`. Also seeing "origin unreachable" on store pushes and a
"Cannot rebase onto multiple branches" retry from `aida add` — BUG-1461/1462 are local-only
until the store leg pushes.

-- reviewer (claude-reviewer-1)
